presence_immersion.query: I felt like I was really there, fully immersed in the environment

bodily_dissolution.query: I lost the sense of my body, felt disembodied or dissolved

relaxation_calm.query: I felt calm, relaxed and at peace

anxiety_unease.query: I felt anxious, uneasy or uncomfortable

time_distortion.query: my sense of time changed, time felt distorted

connection.query: I felt connected to something larger than myself

vividness_realness.query: the experience felt vivid and real

floating_lightness.query: I felt light, floating or weightless

body_awareness.query: I became strongly aware of sensations in my body

emotional_intensity.query: I felt a strong, intense emotion
